title: LivingBookMagazineItemV1
description: Schema for an addressable, federatable Magazine delta item in a Living Book.

id.description: Unique addressable identifier for the magazine item.

source_book.description: Living Book ID where this item was originally published (canonical source).

event_at.description: Optional date when the documented event or trace occurred.

title.description: Title of the chronicle or delta item.

short.description: Concise summary (1-2 sentences) suitable for feeds and syndication.

medium.description: Paragraph-length summary describing the findings and impact.

epistemic_status.description: Epistemic status of the statement or delta.

canonical_ref.description: URL or relative repo path to the canonical full-text article or trace.

syndication.description: Present when this item is a contextual projection syndicated into another Living Book.

syndicated_by.description: Book ID of the consuming Living Book that syndicated this item.

syndicated_at.description: Timestamp when this item was syndicated into the consuming book.

contextual_note.description: Editorial rationale explaining why this delta is projected into the consuming book.

source_authority_preserved.description: Explicit declaration that source authority is NOT cloned into the consuming book.
